rows.label: Rows of the table
rows.hint: One row per line: the number of correct answers, then the scaled score, for example "12 5.5" (pasting from a spreadsheet works). The raw numbers must run from 0 without a gap and the scaled score must never fall. A line with one number is the score of the next raw value.
rows.preview: The table that will be saved ({{count}} rows)
rows.caption: The score table that will be saved

new.title: New score table
new.description: A table that turns correct answers into the score of one skill of an exam. The default table of an exam belongs to English9x; a table for a single test comes with the test builder.
new.scope: Scope: the default of the exam.

edit.title: Score table {{skill}}
edit.savedNewVersion: A new draft was made, version {{n}}. The published version is unchanged.
edit.submitted: Submitted for review. This version is locked until the reviewer decides.
edit.publishedNote: This version is published and cannot be edited. Saving makes a new draft (version {{next}}).
edit.inReviewNote: This version is waiting for review and is locked.
edit.archivedNote: This version is archived and cannot be edited.
edit.functionNote: This score is computed by the function {{function}}; there is no table to edit.
edit.notFound: The table does not exist, or you may not open it in this context.

list.title: Score tables
list.description: The tables that turn correct answers into scores for the exams you write or review, each showing its latest version.
list.caption: Score tables

errors.invalid: The table is not valid. Fix the items below and save again.
errors.testScope: A table for a single test cannot be used yet; make the default table of the exam.
errors.exists: This exam already has a table for that score. Open it in the list to edit it.
errors.underReview: The latest version is being reviewed and cannot be edited.
errors.anotherAuthor: This draft belongs to another author; only they can edit or submit it.
errors.notEditable: There is no draft to submit.
errors.conflict: Somebody just changed this table. Reload and try again.
errors.forbidden: You may not do this with this table.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Try again in a few minutes.
